Handel: born German, became British; country is disputed

rows.label: John Williams
rows.hook: wrote the thundering themes for Star Wars, Jaws and Indiana Jones

rows.label: Ludwig van Beethoven
rows.hook: kept writing towering symphonies, including the Ode to Joy finale, after going deaf

rows.label: Johann Sebastian Bach
rows.hook: wrote the Brandenburg Concertos and a famous Toccata and Fugue for organ in the Baroque era

rows.label: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
rows.hook: wrote the ballets Swan Lake and The Nutcracker, plus an overture with real cannon fire

rows.label: Antonio Vivaldi
rows.hook: wrote The Four Seasons, a set of violin concertos, and was nicknamed the Red Priest

rows.label: Sergei Rachmaninoff
rows.hook: was a towering-handed pianist famed for his dark, romantic Second and Third Piano Concertos

rows.label: Franz Schubert
rows.hook: wrote hundreds of songs and an Unfinished Symphony before dying in his early thirties

rows.label: Gustav Mahler
rows.hook: wrote enormous late-Romantic symphonies, including the Resurrection and the Symphony of a Thousand

rows.label: Antonio Salieri
rows.hook: is remembered, thanks to a stage play and film, as the jealous rival of Mozart

rows.label: Claude Debussy
rows.hook: wrote the dreamy Clair de Lune and the orchestral piece Prelude to the Afternoon of a Faun

rows.label: Philip Glass
rows.hook: is the best-known minimalist, whose music uses hypnotic repeating patterns, as in Einstein on the Beach

rows.label: Antonín Dvořák
rows.hook: wrote the Symphony From the New World after visiting America

rows.label: George Frideric Handel
rows.hook: wrote the oratorio Messiah, with its rousing Hallelujah chorus, and Water Music for a royal barge party

rows.label: Johannes Brahms
rows.hook: wrote a famous lullaby and the Hungarian Dances, and was a friend and champion of Clara Schumann

rows.label: Igor Stravinsky
rows.hook: caused a riot at the premiere of his ballet The Rite of Spring

rows.label: Joseph Haydn
rows.hook: is called the Father of the Symphony and taught Beethoven in Vienna

rows.label: Edward Elgar
rows.hook: wrote the Enigma Variations and the Pomp and Circumstance march played at graduations

rows.label: Edvard Grieg
rows.hook: wrote the Peer Gynt suite, including In the Hall of the Mountain King

rows.label: Maurice Ravel
rows.hook: wrote Boléro, a piece that builds one repeating melody from a quiet start to a huge climax

rows.label: Erik Satie
rows.hook: wrote the calm, spare piano pieces Gymnopédies and Gnossiennes, an early taste of ambient music

rows.label: Jean Sibelius
rows.hook: wrote the patriotic tone poem Finlandia and a famous violin concerto

rows.label: Niccolò Paganini
rows.hook: was a legendary virtuoso violinist, rumored to have made a deal with the devil, famed for his 24 Caprices

rows.label: Aaron Copland
rows.description: American composer, composition teacher, writer, and conductor (1900-1990)
rows.hook: wrote Appalachian Spring and Fanfare for the Common Man, defining a wide-open American sound

rows.label: Camille Saint-Saëns
rows.description: French composer, organist, conductor and pianist (1835–1921)
rows.hook: wrote The Carnival of the Animals and the Organ Symphony

rows.label: Clara Schumann
rows.hook: was a celebrated child-prodigy pianist who toured Europe and wed fellow composer Robert

rows.label: Johann Strauss II
rows.hook: was the Waltz King, who wrote The Blue Danube and the operetta Die Fledermaus

rows.label: Gioachino Rossini
rows.hook: wrote The Barber of Seville and the William Tell Overture, whose finale was the Lone Ranger's theme

rows.label: Alexander Scriabin
rows.hook: wrote mystical, colorful music and reportedly saw sounds as colors

rows.label: Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov
rows.hook: wrote Scheherazade and The Flight of the Bumblebee while serving as a naval officer turned teacher

rows.label: Henry Purcell
rows.hook: wrote the opera Dido and Aeneas, with its heartbreaking lament, in the Baroque era
